# M3TAL Environment Variables Reference

This document provides a comprehensive reference for all environment variables used by the M3TAL ecosystem. These variables control the behavior, networking, storage, and security of your M3TAL deployment.

All M3TAL environment variables are read from the `/etc/m3tal/.env` file. This file is managed by the `m3tal config wizard` and can be updated using `m3tal config set KEY value`. Both the M3TAL CLI and all Docker Compose stacks utilize this file via the `--env-file` option.

## Quick Reference Table

| Variable Name            | Description                                                                                                         | Default Value      |
| ----------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------ |
| **Core**                |                                                                                                                     |                    |
| `LOG_LEVEL`             | Sets the logging level for M3TAL services.                                                                          | `info`             |
| `DEBUG_MODE`            | Enables or disables debug mode for enhanced logging and diagnostics.                                                  | `false`            |
| `METRICS_ENABLED`       | Enables or disables the collection of service metrics.                                                              | `true`             |
| `PUID`                  | The user ID for running containers.                                                                                 | `1000`             |
| `PGID`                  | The group ID for running containers.                                                                                | `1000`             |
| `TZ`                    | The timezone to be used by services.                                                                                | `America/Denver`   |
| **Auth**                |                                                                                                                     |                    |
| `DASHBOARD_SECRET`      | Secret key for the M3TAL dashboard. **Auto-generated on first `m3tal init`. Rotate if compromised.**                 | `change_me_immediately` |
| `API_TOKEN`             | API token for authentication. **Auto-generated on first `m3tal init`. Rotate if compromised.**                       | `change_me_api_token` |
| `ADMIN_PASSWORD`        | Password for the administrative user of the dashboard.                                                              | `admin_pass`       |
| **Network**             |                                                                                                                     |                    |
| `HTTP_PORT`             | The port on which the M3TAL API daemon listens.                                                                     | `8080`             |
| `NETWORK_NAME`          | The name of the Docker network used by M3TAL services.                                                              | `m3tal`            |
| `LOCAL_IP`              | The local IP address that M3TAL services will bind to.                                                              | `127.0.0.1`        |
| `DOMAIN`                | The primary domain name for M3TAL services. Used for Traefik routing (e.g., `dash.DOMAIN`, `api.DOMAIN`).         | `localhost`        |
| `VPN_USER`              | Username for VPN access.                                                                                            | `user`             |
| `VPN_PASSWORD`          | Password for VPN access.                                                                                            | `password`         |
| **Storage**             |                                                                                                                     |                    |
| `BASE_STORAGE_PATH`     | The base path for all M3TAL data storage. Defaults to `/mnt` in production deployments.                             | `./data`           |
| `MEDIA_PATH`            | The path within `BASE_STORAGE_PATH` for storing media files.                                                        | `./data/media`     |
| `CONFIG_PATH`           | The path within `BASE_STORAGE_PATH` for storing configuration files.                                                | `./data/config`    |
| `DOWNLOADS_PATH`        | The path within `BASE_STORAGE_PATH` for storing downloaded files.                                                   | `./data/downloads` |
| `STATE_DIR`             | The directory where the M3TAL state database is stored.                                                             | `./state`          |
| **Traefik**             |                                                                                                                     |                    |
| `DASHBOARD_PORT`        | The port on which the M3TAL dashboard container listens internally.                                                 | `8082`             |
| `DASHBOARD_EXPOSE_MODE` | Controls how the dashboard is exposed: `local` (direct port) or `traefik` (via Traefik reverse proxy).              | `local`            |
| `TRAEFIK_WEB_PORT`      | The host port that Traefik uses for HTTP traffic.                                                                   | `80`               |
| `TRAEFIK_WEBHTTPS_PORT` | The host port that Traefik uses for HTTPS traffic.                                                                  | `443`              |
| `TRAEFIK_DASHBOARD_PORT`| The host port on which the Traefik dashboard is accessible locally.                                                 | `8080`             |
| **System**              |                                                                                                                     |                    |

---

## Detailed Environment Variable Reference

### Core

| Variable Name | Description                                                                          | Default Value | Example Value | Used By           |
| ------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ | ------------- | ------------- | ----------------- |
| `LOG_LEVEL`   | Sets the logging level for M3TAL services. Available levels: `debug`, `info`, `warn`, `error`. | `info`        | `debug`       | API Daemon, CLI   |
| `DEBUG_MODE`  | Enables or disables debug mode for enhanced logging and diagnostics.                 | `false`       | `true`        | API Daemon, CLI   |
| `METRICS_ENABLED` | Enables or disables the collection of service metrics.                             | `true`        | `false`       | API Daemon        |
| `PUID`        | The user ID for running containers. This ensures containers run with the correct permissions. | `1000`        | `1001`        | Dashboard Container, API Daemon |
| `PGID`        | The group ID for running containers. This ensures containers run with the correct permissions. | `1000`        | `1001`        | Dashboard Container, API Daemon |
| `TZ`          | The timezone to be used by services. This ensures logs and timestamps are accurate. | `America/Denver` | `UTC`         | Dashboard Container, API Daemon |

### Auth

| Variable Name | Description                                                                                                                                                               | Default Value             | Example Value               | Used By           |
| ------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------- | --------------------------- | ----------------- |
| `DASHBOARD_SECRET` | Secret key for the M3TAL dashboard. This is used for session management and security. **Auto-generated on first `m3tal init`. Rotate if compromised.**               | `change_me_immediately`   | `your_new_secret_key_here` | Dashboard Container |
| `API_TOKEN`      | API token for authentication. This token is used to authenticate requests to the M3TAL API. **Auto-generated on first `m3tal init`. Rotate if compromised.**              | `change_me_api_token`     | `your_new_api_token_here`   | API Daemon        |
| `ADMIN_PASSWORD` | Password for the administrative user of the dashboard.                                                                                                                    | `admin_pass`              | `a_very_strong_password`    | Dashboard Container |

### Network

| Variable Name | Description                                                                                                                                                                   | Default Value | Example Value      | Used By                 |
| ------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------- | ------------------ | ----------------------- |
| `HTTP_PORT`   | The port on which the M3TAL API daemon listens.                                                                                                                               | `8080`        | `8081`             | API Daemon              |
| `NETWORK_NAME`| The name of the Docker network used by M3TAL services. This ensures proper inter-service communication.                                                                      | `m3tal`       | `m3tal_internal`   | CLI, API Daemon, Docker Compose |
| `LOCAL_IP`    | The local IP address that M3TAL services will bind to. Typically `127.0.0.1` for local access or the host's IP for network access.                                           | `127.0.0.1`   | `192.168.1.100`    | API Daemon              |
| `DOMAIN`      | The primary domain name for M3TAL services. When set, Traefik will configure routing rules for `dash.DOMAIN` and `api.DOMAIN`.                                              | `localhost`   | `yourdomain.com`   | Traefik, Dashboard Container, API Daemon |
| `VPN_USER`    | Username for VPN access. This is used if you are configuring M3TAL to connect to a VPN.                                                                                       | `user`        | `vpn_username`     | CLI                     |
| `VPN_PASSWORD`| Password for VPN access. This is used if you are configuring M3TAL to connect to a VPN.                                                                                       | `password`    | `vpn_password`     | CLI                     |
